test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers is NOT divisible by 6.

(i) 1,97,232

(ii) 9,72,132

(iii) 8,00,552

(iv) 17,90,184
solution:
**Concept used:**

If a number has to be divided by 6 it has tobe divided by both 2 and 3

**Calculation:**

Here all these options are divided by 2 

Again, (i) 1,97,232 , (ii) 9,72,132 and (iv) 17,90,184 is divided by 3 also because sum of digit is divided by 3

But in option (iii) 8,00,552 , the sum of digit is 8 + 5 + 5 + 2 = 20 which is not divided by 3

**∴ The correct option is 2**
